title: Docker-compose development stack
objective: One-command dev environment: API, worker, Redis, Postgres, and local index builder job.
agent_steps: Write docker-compose.yml with api, worker, redis, postgres services and healthchecks.
Volume-mount the repository for hot reload; pin image digests where practical.
Add a Makefile: make dev, make lint, make test, make index-build.
Verify the stack comes up clean from a fresh clone.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up -d reaches healthy state for all services in under 90 seconds.
make test executes inside the worker container against the live stack.
A fresh-clone bring-up succeeds without manual steps.
verification: docker compose up -d && docker compose ps
